summary: Defines the History-Info header for SIP, which records how and why a request reached a particular user or application, for example after being forwarded. This enables enhanced services that depend on call history. It is a standards-track document that was later replaced by RFC 7044.

eli5.summary: Like a trail of sticky notes on a letter saying who passed it on and why. The last person can read the notes and see its journey.

questions: how to track sip call forwarding
